title: Define filter
text:
Define filter. Right now im not too impressed. Bought 2..
Filtered already filtered water that had 40-50 particulates, after running through the filter once it only removed 15 particulates according to a tds tester. I will try with tap since it has over 800 particulates and see if it does a better job.
